subject: Compliance packaging and cost allocation for audit logs / HSM / residency
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthgrid.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.com, mike.alvarez@healthgrid.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-on scope and initial pricing ask

Jonas / Redwood team,

Thanks for the call this morning. HealthGrid is planning a PHI-enabled pilot and we need a clearer commercial model for the following items before legal will proceed: audit log retention and ingest pricing, KMS/HSM seat vs throughput pricing, and the data residency surcharge for EU/US split (we will have mixed workloads).

Can you provide: a) a sample commercial split that moves some implementation work into credits, b) an amortization view for one-time evidence delivery vs recurring surcharge, and c) an example for HSM seat vs per-token throughput so we can build internal costs?

We attached a short requirements doc (HealthGrid_REQS_20270422.pdf). Target timeline: contract signed in May, pilot in June.

Key constraints: 12-month committed minimum for production, procurement requires any one-time implementation fee to be <= 30% of year-one ARR unless offset by credits.

Thanks,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Procurement | HealthGrid
procurement@healthgrid.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthgrid.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on scope and initial pricing ask

Sara — really appreciate the clarity and the requirements doc. High level response and two commercial paths below; attaching a proposal PDF with line items (Redwood_Compliance_Proposal_v1.pdf).

Option A (Commit-forward, lower upfront):
- One-time evidence delivery/setup: $60k implemented; we can amortize as $5k/mo over 12 months as a credit against usage if HealthGrid signs a 12-month commit >= $200k ARR.
- Audit log: tiered ingest pricing: first 5TB/mo included, 5–25TB at $0.08/GB, >25TB at $0.05/GB. Retention tiers: 90 days included, 365 days at $0.01/GB/mo, 7 years (archival) negotiated separately.
- KMS/HSM: managed KMS included; HSM (FIPS-validated module) priced as $2,500/month per HSM seat for full key custody, or a throughput-based option at $0.0009/token-equivalent for high-volume signing flows.
- Residency surcharge: 8% uplift for EU data residency (covering dedicated nodes & audit routing).

Option B (Upfront-first, lower unit):
- Evidence/setup: $90k one-time; can be offset by $30k credit if HealthGrid accepts a 24-month commit.
- Audit log: slightly lower per-GB rates and retention fees; pilot month free.
- HSM: discounted seat pricing (25% off) with minimum 3-seat commitment; throughput option available for bursty workloads.

Notes / tradeoffs:
- We typically move heavy evidence work (SOC attestation artifacts, mapping audit schemas) into the setup bucket. If you need accelerated onboarding (2–3 week window) there will be a premium.
- We can split the implementation fee into deliverable milestones tied to SOW acceptance to help procurement cashflow.

Next steps: Marissa (cc’d) is our solutions lead for implementation scoping — Marissa, can you sync with HealthGrid on the retention and ingest volume profile (monthly averages and peak)? Ben, please prepare a short tech appendix on HSM throughput equivalence and sample billing math.

I’ll follow up with a version that converts the proposal into a redline-friendly commercial worksheet if we get alignment on volumes.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197

Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_Proposal_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthgrid.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on scope and initial pricing ask — tech appendix

Sara / team — quick technical appendix and worked example to translate seat vs throughput for HSM and how audit log retention maps to storage cost. See inline examples below.

HSM equivalence model (worked example):
- Typical signing workload for HealthGrid pilot: 200k signing ops/day (~6M/month).
- HSM seat (fixed): $2,500/month provides dedicated key-custody and low-latency signing; covers up to ~8M signing ops/month in our baseline benchmarking. Additional ops billed at $0.0007/op if >8M.
- Throughput option: $0.0009/op, no seat commitment — good for bursty or unpredictable workloads.

Audit log retention storage math (monthly):
- Baseline ingest: 3TB/mo (pilot).
- Storage cost: 3TB * $0.01/GB for 365-day retention = ~$30/mo. Long-term archival (7 years) moves to cold storage pricing and is charged separately; we can include a provisional estimate in the SOW.

Pilot credit suggestion:
- One month of full platform access (including audit log at 365-day retention and one HSM seat) as a trial credit if you sign a pilot SOW by May 7. This reduces implementation friction and lets us gather real ingest numbers.

Attachments: none in this message (proposal PDF attached earlier).

—Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthgrid.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthgrid.com, mike.alvarez@healthgrid.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on scope and initial pricing ask

Thanks Jonas / Ben — that is helpful. Procurement and legal reviewed Option A and here are our asks/counterpoints:

1) Implementation fee: we can accept $60k if Redwood converts $25k into an upfront credit applied over the first 6 months of usage (i.e., $4,166/mo credit) — this keeps our cashflow target and meets the <=30% rule.
2) HSM: we prefer the seat model for low-latency production flows, but request 2 seats at 15% discount for the pilot-to-prod window (first 6 months).
3) Audit logs: agree to the tiering but ask that the first 10TB/mo be included for the pilot period (90 days) to stabilize volumes.
4) Residency surcharge: 5% for pilot phase then re-evaluate at 12-month renewal.

Legal also flagged SOC 2 attestation evidence delivery and asked Redwood to commit to providing the artifact set within 30 days of SOW signature. We attached a redline of the SOW (HealthGrid_SOW_redlines.docx) with comments on evidence timing and acceptance criteria. Procurement also asked for a DocuSign-ready MSA link prior to finance approvals.

If Redwood can accept items 1–4 and confirm the SOC 2 artifact timeline, procurement is ready to move to signature upon a revised commercial worksheet.

Regards,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Procurement | HealthGrid

Attachment: HealthGrid_SOW_redlines.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on scope and initial pricing ask — revised commercial path

Sara — thanks for the clear counterproposal. We can accept the majority of your asks with the following revised commercial terms: 

- Implementation fee: $60k with $25k applied as an upfront credit distributed as $4,166/month over months 1–6. (Accepted)
- HSM: Two seats at 15% discount for the first 6 months, after which standard seat pricing resumes unless a 12-month seat commitment is confirmed. (Accepted)
- Audit logs: First 10TB/mo included for pilot 90-day window. Post-pilot, revert to tiered ingest pricing from proposal. (Accepted)
- Residency surcharge: 5% during pilot; will re-evaluate at renewal. (Accepted)
- SOC 2 artifacts: Redwood will deliver the SOC 2 evidence package within 30 days of SOW signature; we will include specific delivery checklist in the SOW exhibit. (Accepted)

Next steps: I will circulate a revised commercial worksheet and an updated SOW exhibit addressing the evidence checklist and milestone schedule by EOD today. Once you confirm the worksheet we will generate a DocuSign envelope for the MSA and SOW.

Marissa / Ben — please prepare the updated worksheet and the SOW exhibit (evidence checklist + milestone payment schedule). Sara / Procurement — if you can confirm by EOD Monday we will lock pricing and prepare the DocuSign package.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into onboarding.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Compliance_Proposal_v1.pdf, HealthGrid_REQS_20270422.pdf
